title: Park Lighting
statementMd:
Due to the coronavirus pandemic, city authorities obligated citizens to keep a social distance. The mayor of the city Semyon wants to light up Gluharniki park so that people could see each other even at night to keep the social distance.

The park is a rectangular table with $n$ rows and $m$ columns, where the cells of the table are squares, and the boundaries between the cells are streets. External borders are also streets. Every street has length $1$. For example, park with $n=m=2$ has $12$ streets.

You were assigned to develop a plan for lighting the park. You can put lanterns in the middle of the streets. The lamp lights two squares near it (or only one square if it stands on the border of the park).

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7df5389fd8c341033accde7fd22d03802e1fd9e1.png) The park sizes are: $n=4$, $m=5$. The lighted squares are marked yellow. Please note that all streets have length $1$. Lanterns are placed in the middle of the streets. In the picture **not all** the squares are lit.

Semyon wants to spend the least possible amount of money on lighting but also wants people throughout the park to keep a social distance. So he asks you to find the minimum number of lanterns that are required to light all the squares.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $t$ ($1 \le t \le 10^4$) — the number of test cases in the input. Then $t$ test cases follow.

Each test case is a line containing two integers $n$, $m$ ($1 \le n, m \le 10^4$) — park sizes.

## Output

Print $t$ answers to the test cases. Each answer must be a single integer — the minimum number of lanterns that are required to light all the squares.

## Note

Possible optimal arrangement of the lanterns for the $2$-nd test case of input data example: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ea885fae2457a5c0d0494300d1cd2279f14fc2a2.png)

Possible optimal arrangement of the lanterns for the $3$-rd test case of input data example: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d2647da857f242032940a341ee0f72cd7a3713d9.png)
statementZhMd:
由于新冠疫情，城市管理部门要求市民保持社交距离。城市市长 Semyon 想要为 Gluharniki 公园提供照明，使人们即使在夜间也能看见彼此，从而保持社交距离。

公园是一个有 $n$ 行 $m$ 列的矩形网格，网格中的每个单元格都是正方形，单元格之间的边界是街道。公园的外边界同样也是街道。每条街道的长度均为 $1$。例如，一个 $n=m=2$ 的公园有 $12$ 条街道。

你的任务是制定公园的照明方案。你可以将路灯放置在街道的中点。每盏路灯可以照亮其旁边的两个正方形（如果路灯位于公园边界上，则只能照亮一个正方形）。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7df5389fd8c341033accde7fd22d03802e1fd9e1.png)公园的大小为：$n=4$，$m=5$。被照亮的正方形用黄色标记。请注意，所有街道的长度均为 $1$。路灯放置在街道的中点。在图中，并非所有正方形都被照亮。

Semyon 希望在照明上花费尽可能少的钱，同时也希望公园中的所有人都能保持社交距离。因此，他请你求出照亮所有正方形所需的最少路灯数量。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^4$）——输入中的测试用例数量。接下来是 $t$ 个测试用例。

每个测试用例占一行，包含两个整数 $n$、$m$（$1 \le n, m \le 10^4$）——公园的大小。

## 输出格式

输出 $t$ 个测试用例的答案。每个答案占一行，为一个整数，表示照亮所有正方形所需的最少路灯数量。

## 说明

输入样例中第 $2$ 个测试用例的一种最优路灯摆放方案：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ea885fae2457a5c0d0494300d1cd2279f14fc2a2.png)

输入样例中第 $3$ 个测试用例的一种最优路灯摆放方案：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d2647da857f242032940a341ee0f72cd7a3713d9.png)
